ownerApproval.instruction: no i want it, go ahead
ownerApproval.scope: Isolated local benchmark as proposed; research encoder excluded from tracker

scope: Python-only research comparator using a frozen multilingual encoder and one completion classifier; not an exportable SMS runtime candidate

encoder.pooling: attention-mask mean over last hidden states, including unmasked special tokens, matching the published example
encoder.overflowPolicy: Before fitting, stop if any frozen training or scored diagnostic input exceeds 128 tokenizer tokens. Report exact cases; do not silently truncate, drop, relabel or change the limit.
encoder.embeddingNormalization: none; no L2 normalization, scaler, prompt, PCA or feature selection
encoder.preprocessing: Reuse src.python.research.sms_semantics.normalize exactly; pass identical normalized strings to the pinned tokenizer. Preserve this controlled preprocessing even though the model's own default does not lowercase.

cohort.weighting: Keep original 1014 row weights/groups. Each new four-member bilingual contrast group totals one unit, weight 0.25 per member. No class rebalance.
cohort.trainingViewEncoding: Ordered original completion rows, then expanded research_training contrasts. Object keys recordId,text,target,weight,group. Original group=weightGroup; new group='context:'+authoringGroupId. JSON ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8, no trailing newline.

classifier.inputDtype: float64, cast from cached float32 mean-pooled vectors
classifier.boundary: positive iff signed decision score > 0, ties negative
classifier.convergenceFailure: Stop, retain attempt ledger, no extra fit or automatic solver adjustment

evaluation.status: All existing diagnostics exposed and assistant-labeled; not independent accuracy or a final test
cohorts: unchanged 24 manual diagnostics, two uncertain excluded from binary truth
14 exposed quote conformance controls, uncertain cases excluded from binary truth and overlapping examples reported separately
metrics: TP/TN/FP/FN per cohort and Arabic/English slice
uncertain cases separately, never forced negative
token lengths, download/asset bytes, peak resident memory and warm CPU latency excluding download/startup

continuationGate.purpose: Proposed gate for considering a student experiment, not release thresholds or deployment approval
continuationGate.falseCompleted: Zero on each definite development cohort, including all OTP/declined/pending/example controls
continuationGate.missedCompleted: No worse than the context reference in each primary cohort and language slice; report all case swaps
continuationGate.criticalRegressions: No new OTP, refusal or ordinary-chat acceptance versus either reference
continuationGate.ifFailed: Retain negative result; no student, automatic alternative model, head refit, threshold tuning or promotion

runtimeBoundary.strictRuntimeParity: Required for any subsequent shippable student/export; this comparator stays outside all runtime engines

implementationOrder: Record owner approval for this exact research scope before fitting; proposed status does not authorize a fit
Create isolated dependency environment, resolve and record package versions without modifying the current engine environment
Fetch only the pinned model/tokenizer/config/license files into an ignored cache and verify their hashes; record all download sizes; no SMS uploads
Reconstruct frozen data using checked artifacts/snapshots, not old prepare functions against changed live rule bindings; verify training view SHA and target/group counts
Preflight all tokenizer lengths without inference, truncation or fitting; stop on overlength inputs
Verify deterministic frozen eval-mode encoding and cache input/model/vector hashes locally; finite vectors only
Write immutable input/cohort/environment/start ledger before the sole weighted classifier fit
Export the 384-weight head with pooling/tokenizer/encoder bindings and check solver versus ordered float64 dot products
Evaluate fixed cohorts once; report raw learned results separately from structural recording behavior and all regressions
Stop after the comparison. Do not create a student, migrate the active engine, use reserved final folds or publish
limits: Pretrained semantic similarity representations do not establish reliable completion, negation, quotation, settlement, ownership or Jordanian dialect understanding
113 weighting groups are not 113 independent received-SMS families; no independent Jordan SMS final test exists
PyTorch/transformers/tokenizer runtimes are not installed in the current project Python environment; dependency installation/download costs are additional to approximately 471 MB of encoder weights
CPU and future Hermes latency are unknown; the existing under-0.10ms Hermes requirement is unmeasured
A later compact sequence student needs a separately fixed data/objective/export/parity/latency protocol and approval; successful distillation is not assumed
